plugin.name: IntelEngine
plugin.description:
AI-powered NPC autonomy mod for Skyrim. Gives NPCs the ability to travel, perform tasks, and create dynamic story events powered by SkyrimNet's LLM integration.
Features: - Player-directed NPC tasks (GoToLocation, FetchPerson, DeliverMessage, SearchForActor, ScheduleMeeting, EscortTarget) - LLM Dungeon Master story events (seek_player, informant, road_encounter, ambush, stalker, message, quest) - Autonomous NPC social interactions (npc_interaction, npc_gossip) - All features configurable via MCM
Requirements: SKSE, SkyrimNet Beta 25 or newer, PapyrusExtender (po3), PapyrusUtil, MCM Helper

plugin.name: Legacy save converter and FAQ
plugin.description:
Continuing an IntelEngine 3.5.2 playthrough? Select this to install the converter and player FAQ in Data\IntelEngine Tools. Starting a fresh game? You do not need conversion. This option is unselected by default because only players bringing an eligible 3.5.2 save forward need these tools.
1. Close Skyrim. 2. Back up the matching .ess and .skse files and keep them together in the same folder. Back up IntelEngine and SkyrimNet's extra data too if you might roll back. 3. Drag exactly one .ess onto Convert-IE-Save.bat in IntelEngine Tools; leave its matching .skse beside the save. 4. After successful conversion, install this release's complete package and load the new _IEconverted save with its matching _IEconverted.skse alongside it.
Skyrim 1.6.1170 and 1.7.104 only; VR saves are not convertible. The tool refuses saves it cannot qualify and cannot recover already-lost names. It leaves your originals untouched. Do not load an incomplete converted pair, mix original and converted files, or convert the same save again. Never load a converted save with IntelEngine 3.5.2.
If your save folder is a link or junction (including redirected or OneDrive folders), copy the .ess/.skse pair to a normal folder first and drag the .ess from there.
Windows SmartScreen may warn because the tool is unsigned: choose More info -> Run anyway.
Read FAQ.md in IntelEngine Tools for more guidance.
